-
 def get_schema_from_model_field(

@@ -187,9 +180,12 @@ def get_schema_from_model_field(

pr_title: Compute the computed-field override once per field set
pr_description: _has_computed_fields re-ran the same core-schema lookup for every field it was asked about. This inlines the check and hoists a single has_computed_fields/override_mode computation into get_definitions, reusing that result across the validation and serialization field lists instead of recalculating it per field.
